tunes.title: Abbey

tunes.attribution: William Tans’ur; published in The Harmony of Zion, second edition, 1734.

tunes.attribution: Published in William Barton’s Psalms, 1706.

tunes.title: Croft’s Hundred Thirty-Sixth
tunes.attribution: William Croft; published before his death in 1727.
